name: Vampir
summary: Rust widget toolkit for GPUI apps: buttons, fields, menus, pop-ups and tables over a small OKLCH palette.
description: A widget toolkit for building GPUI desktop apps in Rust, with a physical-surface style — lit panels, raised controls, recessed fields — shared through lighting helpers. Controls (button, switch, checkbox, slider, textfield, combo, table, tabs, dialog, tooltip, command palette and more) take a value, palette and context and return an element, so they own no app state; the theme derives from a hue, saturation and light/dark scheme that can follow the desktop. A gallery app demonstrates every widget; core depends only on gpui-ce and unicode-segmentation; MIT licensed.
contains: controls: button, iconbutton, switch, checkbox, radiogroup, segmented, chip, spinbox, textfield, textarea, combo
more controls: slider, progressbar, spinner, badge, separator, scrollbar, caption, fading text
containers: tab bar, split, collapsible, dialog, card, scroll area, row / column
menus and overlays: nested context menus, menubutton, tooltip, command palette and search lists with fuzzy matching
data: draggable tab bar, flattened tree, sortable table header, selectable list
theme from hue and saturation with a light/dark scheme that can follow the desktop
physical-surface style: lit, raised, recessed, panel, rim, glow, shade and ground helpers
gallery app with every widget in one window; macOS menu bar demo; MIT licensed; core depends only on gpui-ce
